title: Runtime Bundle Builder
summary: The Bundle Builder converts multiple source files with internal ::REQUIRES into a single, immutable, hashed source closure.
why: Allows for independent, reloadable code closures that do not collide with other versions of the same classes in the same process.
invariants: The resulting bundle is the artifact that is hashed, signed, and promoted.
evidence_note: Source: runtime_registry_v0.14/README.md:185-195. Line 187: 'RuntimeBundleBuilder deterministically creates one generation-private source closure.'
